name: SVR Poker Android

tablePolicy.humanRejoinBehavior: A deliberate leave clears the interrupted hand. JOIN TABLE starts a fresh six-player test table with 15,000 chips per seat.

androidExperience.audioMode: Web Audio synthesized poker effects with no missing-file dependency

required: Lobby starts with no visible cards
Exactly one JOIN TABLE / LEAVE TABLE control
Complete hand settles while conserving 90,000 chips
LEAVE returns to lobby and clears cards
Verified GLB or FBX table is authority
No browser errors or failed asset requests

realDeviceValidation.target: Verify gyro smoothing, touch drag, portrait/landscape FOV, vibration, seated left-right head movement, and one JOIN/LEAVE control on the owner Android device.

updateMessage: An optional SVR Poker Android update is available.
updateMenuPolicy: Hidden unless releaseReady is true, apkUrl is non-empty, and apkVersionCode is newer than the installed code.
notes: Phase 363 changes the remotely loaded Android web runtime and does not require reinstalling APK 0.1.0-rc1.
Phase 336 remains the poker rules and payout authority.
Phase 347 remains the only Android MOVE, LOOK, and poker-button controller.
Phase 357 remains the protected Android table/status/seating presentation authority.
Phase 363 adds the final Android lobby/seated state, 15,000-chip test bankroll, one JOIN/LEAVE control, audio, haptics, gyro/touch view, responsive FOV, and verified table asset authority.
No OBJ table is checked into the repository; the verified GLB is preferred and the verified FBX remains fallback.
APK version name 0.1.0-rc1, version code 1, manual-update-only, forceUpdate false, and showUpdatePrompt false remain locked.
